limits.counts: The word count includes the Summary, Introduction, Results, Discussion, Materials and methods, Acknowledgements, table titles and figure legends (Author Guidelines updated June 2026, read in a browser 2026-11-16).
limits.notes: The Plant Journal's Author Guidelines, 'updated June 2026' (read in a browser 2026-11-16). Typical length 7000–9000 words with 3–7 figures and/or tables (a typical range, not a hard cap: the upper ends are used here). Summary no more than 250 words; summary_words is the Significance statement, up to two sentences and no more than 75 words in total; up to 10 keywords, in order of importance, on the title page. Text-file order: title page, Summary, Significance statement, Introduction, Results, Discussion, Materials and methods (with a 'Disclosure of AI Use' section where AI tools were used), Data statement (with the nucleotide and amino-acid accession numbers; no separate Accession numbers section), other statements as needed (e.g. conflict of interest, also given in the submission system), Acknowledgements (all funding sources), short Supporting Information legends under 'Supporting Information', References (Harvard). An Author Contributions section is encouraged. Figure panels in lower-case letters; numbers under 10 spelt out except with units, ages or in lists with other numbers; tables without vertical rules, footnote symbols †, ‡, §, ¶ with *, **, *** kept for P values; British or US spelling, consistent within the article. Earlier (2026-11-13) only the Society for Experimental Biology's page could be read: 'No formatting requirements for initial submission of papers'.

The author guidelines: the Internet Archive's copy of 2022-10-25 (the newest it has), read 2026-11-16. Old. Its text-file order: (1) Summary, at most 250 words; (2) Significance statement, one or two sentences and at most 75 words; (3) Introduction; (4) Results; (5) Discussion; (6) Experimental procedures; (7) Accession numbers; (8) Acknowledgements; (9) short legends for the Supporting Information; (10) References; (11) Tables; (12) Figure legends. 'Please provide up to 10 keywords'. A mandatory 'Data Statement section'. No author-contributions section. The conflict of interest statement is given in the submission process.
